build_ActivationQuantFusionPass: build a compilation pass that fuses silu_and_mul with fp8 and nvfp4 quantization patterns in torch fx graphs
create_SiluMulFp8StaticQuantPattern: create a pattern matcher that fuses silu_and_mul with fp8 static tensor quantization into a single fused op
create_SiluMulNvfp4QuantPattern: create a pattern matcher that fuses silu_and_mul with nvfp4 dynamic quantization into a single fused op
create_SiluMulBlockQuantPattern: create a pattern matcher that fuses silu_and_mul with fp8 dynamic per-block quantization supporting group sizes 64 and 128
run_ActivationQuantFusionPass: run the activation quant fusion pass on a torch fx graph to replace silu_and_mul+quant patterns with fused ops
